finding.title: Recover the idle countdown after a malformed MTP reply
finding.scenario: Send MTP OFF on a ready model; engine returns mtp_status with mtp_active of the wrong type. The real Swift bridge produces error without request_id. Wait for that error, complete a new generation, then advance the injected continuous clock by the configured full 60-second interval.
finding.expected: The completed operation releases the pending guard or enters bounded recovery, permitting the full idle countdown to resume.
finding.actual: Generation returns hello, engine remains ready/running, mtpConfigurationPending stays true and no automatic unload occurs. OFF has no recovery timeout. Only cancellation/reconfiguration/model reload/manual eject clears the guard.
finding.cause: The added pending flag is cleared by handle only for errors/status events with matching mtpOperationID, or by cancelMTPPreparation. A requestless decoding error takes failActiveTurn, which does not clear it.
finding.impact: Automatic memory release remains disabled for this model session even after later successful use.
finding.recommendation: Handle requestless MTP failures and bound pending configuration recovery; preserve active-operation protection and add this regression to the production lifecycle harness.
